items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He used to work in the State Theatre Orchestra. His name was Trogliano(?). ... The only private tuition I had was with Trogliano(?)

ctx.x: Now, how did you learn the oboe? Did you have a teacher?

Yeah, I went to a teacher. He used to work in the State Theatre Orchestra. His name was Trogliano(?). He was a very good oboe player himself. I didn't think much of his teaching, because he didn't teach me much. He taught me very little. In fact, he had me on the C scale for six months, and I wanted to learn how to read fast, because I was playing with the school symphony, and then the kids in them bands, they had been studying for years on them violins
